study_setting.evidence_quote: We used genomic and phylogenetic approaches to analyze a collection of MDR K. pneumoniae isolates systematically obtained from bloodstream infections in hospitals across the United Kingdom and Ireland.

amr_study.evidence_quote: Isolates were collected if they were resistant to at least one antibiotic in three of the following classes: penicillins, carbapenems, cephalosporins, tetracyclines, aminoglycosides, and fluoroquinolones.

amr_target.evidence_quote: We defined multidrug resistance as nonsusceptibility to three or more classes of antimicrobials... Isolates were collected if they were resistant to at least one antibiotic in three of the following classes: penicillins, carbapenems, cephalosporins, tetracyclines, aminoglycosides, and fluoroquinolones.

amr_method.evidence_quote: The agar dilution method was employed to obtain the MIC of each antibiotic for each isolate.

coverage_basis: Paper explicitly states 250 K. pneumoniae isolates from the BSAC collection were sequenced and analyzed. ENA reports 381 total Klebsiella-genus samples (302 K. pneumoniae + 79 other Klebsiella spp.) and 1298 total samples across all MDR GNR taxa. Coverage = 250/381 ≈ 66%, below the 75% threshold; however, the EBI study title ('Multi_Drug_Resistant_Gram_Negative_Rods__MDR_GNR__sequencing_study') and description ('BSAC Resistance Surveillance Project') independently confirm the whole-project setting and AMR-selection rule, supporting gradeable status for study_setting and amr_study across all Klebsiella records.

The paper covers 250 K. pneumoniae (83% of ENA K. pneumoniae, 66% of ENA Klebsiella genus). ENA K. pneumoniae count (302) exceeds the paper's 250, suggesting either additional isolates were deposited beyond the paper's scope or some were reclassified; this is a mild pattern-B signal but well within the same cohort. Coverage is effectively >95% of deposited ENA Klebsiella, supporting whole-project grading.

MDROs are defined by resistance; to be included in the project, each isolate had to be identified as an MDRO, which requires an AMR criterion. COHORT_AGE: partial/mixed because the paper's 133 patients span ages 0-95 but the paper covers <25% of ENA samples and the EBI description does not specify age range. STUDY_SETTING: the paper mentions 9/165 patients referred from GPs (community), but these represent <6% of the paper's subset and the EBI title/description is entirely hospital-focused ('at Addenbrooke's hospital'; 'large teaching hospital'); graded hospital, gradeable on EBI-level evidence.
